name: beybladexmeta-analytics
description: Monorepo root. The app is split into two independent services: frontend/ (Vite + React) and backend/ (Express, being strangled into backend-py/ FastAPI).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check: npm --prefix backend run check && npm --prefix frontend run check
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it beyblade-dev-db psql -U postgres -d beyblade_tracker
